details.heading: Business Challenge:
details.paragraph: Juara Holding Group needed a centralized Human Resource Information System (HRIS) to replace scattered spreadsheets for managing employees, departments, positions, attendance, and leave across the organization — with staff needing full access from both desktop and mobile devices.

details.heading: Solution:
details.paragraph: I engineered a comprehensive, fully responsive HRIS platform covering the complete employee lifecycle, with a dedicated mobile bottom-navigation layout so field and remote staff can manage attendance and leave directly from their phones. Key modules include:
list: Organization & People management: Departments, positions, and employee records with contract/permanent status tracking.

Time & Attendance with photo verification: Employees clock in/out via selfie photo capture for identity verification, with a real-time dashboard tracking office, WFH, business trip, late, and absent status.
Leave, Overtime & Meeting Room booking: Streamlined approval workflows for daily HR operations.
Recruitment & Work Arrangements: Centralized hiring pipeline and flexible work arrangement management.
Mobile-first responsive design: Fully optimized bottom-nav mobile experience alongside the desktop dashboard, ensuring HR staff and employees can use the system anywhere.

details.heading: Business Challenge:
details.paragraph: CV. Prima Karya Tani needed a modern Point of Sale (POS) web application to streamline daily sales operations, manage inventory in real time, and continue serving customers even when the internet connection is unreliable — a common scenario in agricultural and rural retail environments.

details.heading: Solution:
details.paragraph: I built a full-featured POS web app with a focus on offline-first reliability and a clean operator-friendly UI. Key capabilities include:
list: Offline mode: Cashiers can continue ringing up sales without internet; transactions sync automatically when connectivity returns.
Sales dashboard: Real-time view of daily revenue, top-selling products, and stock alerts.
Inventory management: Stock tracking with low-stock notifications and purchase order workflow.
Multi-user roles: Separate access for cashier, supervisor, and admin with auditable transaction logs.
Responsive UI: Works on tablets and desktop POS terminals.

details.heading: Business & Engineering Challenge:
details.paragraph: Juara Holding Group manages a vast network of Private Blog Network (PBN) websites and servers. Managing individual server health, Google Search Console indexing, domain authority, and traffic trends manually was highly inefficient for SEO specialists.

details.heading: AI-Powered Fullstack Solution:
details.paragraph: I engineered a centralized Server & PBN Monitoring Dashboard integrating the Google Search Console (GSC) API and Google Gemini API. Key capabilities include:
list: Google Search Console Integration: Automated indexing status monitoring, impression tracking, and search visibility metrics across dozens of PBN websites in one control panel.

Gemini AI Traffic & Trend Engine: Leveraged Google Gemini API to analyze traffic patterns in real-time, automatically flagging underperforming PBN domains that need optimization and highlighting surging traffic trends.

Unified SEO Control Room: Empowered SEO specialists to evaluate network-wide domain performance, detect traffic anomalies, and prioritize content/technical optimization from a single intuitive dashboard.
